preconditions.description: The integer n must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The integer m must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The input must consist of two space-separated integers n and m.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the size k of the beautiful set.
The output must contain k lines of coordinates after the first line.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n and 0 <= y <= m and x + y > 0 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All points in the output must satisfy the conditions 0 ≤ x ≤ n, 0 ≤ y ≤ m, and x + y > 0.

postconditions.expression: all((x1 - x2)**2 + (y1 - y2)**2 != int((x1 - x2)**2 + (y1 - y2)**2) for (x1, y1) in points for (x2, y2) in points if (x1, y1) != (x2, y2))
postconditions.description: The distance between any two distinct points in the output must be a non-integer.
